text: Effaying weighed, and made of paper not impregnated with alum. It is to be dried at frift with a gentle heat, but afterwards expelled for five minutes to a beat of 10:00 On cooling, it to the weights together with the fiter; the brown weight of which mult afterwards be fobricked. The fedmena is both included in bottle for a filter than once impregnated with false matter cannot be freed from it again without great difficulty, especially if an internal of one burns intervents.

parsed.modern: Effaying weighed, and made of paper not impregnated with alum. It is to be dried at first with a gentle heat, but afterwards expelled for five minutes to a beat of 10:00 On cooling, it to the weights together with the filter; the brown weight of which must afterwards be subtracted. The sediment is both included in bottle for a filter than once impregnated with saline matter cannot be freed from it again without great difficulty, especially if an interval of some hours intervenes.
